subject. After thoroughly examining and listening, one should sing the glory of God's
activities. In this way, he will be able to constantly remember the divine nature of God. Listening to God and singing His praises is inseparable from the divine nature of God, and
By doing so, man will always remain in the presence of God. From this, one gets freedom from all kinds of fear.
God is the Supreme Soul, who is present in the heart of every living being. In this way, through the above-mentioned listening and
glory-singing method, God invites the entire creation to be in His company. Of God,
this method of listening and glorifying is applicable to everyone, no matter what they are, and from this, they will
achieve ultimate success in every task. There are several categories of humans-- Karmic, knowledgeable; Yogi and unique devotee.
To achieve desired success in all of these, this is the method that applies.
Every person wants to be free from all
types of fear and wants to enjoy the most happiness. To attain this,
the right method, the praise of which is done here in Shrimad Bhagwat, which is said by the great
authority, Shri Shukdev Goswami. By listening to God and singing His praises, all the activities of man

or God is beyond the physical creation, therefore their form and qualities are not physical. The supreme spiritualist
or liberated beings experience them through the advanced experience of their divine knowledge. Therefore, they take interest in the divine qualities of the Lord's
divine plays. In the Bhagavad Gita (4.9), God declares that
their unseen and their actions are all divine, meaning divine. The common person, being controlled by Maya,
believes that God is also like us, therefore he refuses to accept the divine nature of God's name,
form, etc.
The supreme spiritualist does not have interest in any material
object, therefore, having interest in the activities of God is a definite proof
that God is not like us in this material world. It is also confirmed in Vedic texts that God
is one, but He remains engaged in His divine plays with His unique devotees, and along with that, in the form of a part of Baldev, like God, remains present in the hearts of all beings. Therefore, the ultimate perfection of divine experience lies in the listening and imitation of the divine qualities of God, not in
the desire by the non-exclusive to become one with the formless Brahman of God. The real divine bliss
is in the glorification of the divine God, not in the feeling of being situated in His unparalleled form.
But there are some people who, instead of being supremely spiritual, are inferior to them, and who do not show interest in the description of God's
divine activities, but rather they explain such activities of God
with the intention of becoming one with God.

5. Therefore, whoever follows the footprints of the ideal reader or ideal listener, Shukdev Goswami and Maharaj,
Undoubtedly, he will attain salvation just like them. Maharaj,
Parikshit attained salvation only through hearing, and Shukdev Goswami attained salvation only by preaching. Discourse (text) and listening are two of the nine devotional activities, and by partially or wholly following these principles, a person can attain the supreme position. Therefore, the complete lesson of Shrimad Bhagavat, starting from the first verse of Janmadyasya and ending with the last verse of the twelfth canto, Maharaj,
was narrated by Shukdev Goswami for the attainment of salvation by Parikshit. It is mentioned in Padra Puran
that Gautam Muni advised Maharaj Ambarisha to regularly listen to the Parayan of Shrimad Bhagwat by Shukdev Goswami.
Here is its confirmation that Maharaj Ambarisha listened to Shridbhagavat from beginning to end in the same form in which Shukdev Goswami preached it. Therefore, one who
has an interest in Bhagwat should not, by reading some parts from here and some parts from there,
play around with it, but he should follow the footsteps of great kings like Maharaj Ambarisha or Maharaj Parikshit, and listen to it only from an authentic representative of Shukdev Goswami. Etachnirvidyamananimichatamakutobhayam |

द्वारा अपने आप में सन्तुष्ट रहते हैं। इनसे भी ऊपर भगवद्भक्त हैं, जो न तो भौतिक जगत को भोगने
की कामना करते हैं और न इससे छुटकारा पाने की इच्छा करते हैं । वे भगवान्‌ श्रीकृष्ण को तुष्ट करने
में लगे रहते हैं। दूसरे शब्दों मे, भगवद्भक्त अपने लिए कोई कामना नहीं करते। यदि भगवान्‌ की
इच्छा हो, तो भक्त समस्त भौतिक सुविधाओं को स्वीकार करते हैं और यदि भगवान्‌ इसे नहीं चाहते,
तो भक्तगण समस्त प्रकार की सुविधाएँ, यहाँ तक कि मोक्ष को भी, ताक पर रख सकते हैं। नही वे
आत्मतुष्ट (आत्माराम) होते हैं क्योकि वे केवल भगवान्‌ की ही तुष्टि चाहते हैं। इस श्लोक में
श्रीशुकदेव गोस्वामी भगवान्‌ के दिव्य कीर्तन की संस्तुति करते हैं । भगवान्‌ के पवित्र नाम के निरपराध
भाव से कीर्तन तथा श्रवण से मनुष्य पहले भगवान्‌ के दिव्य रूप से परिचित होता है, फिर भगवान्‌ के
गुणों से और तब उनकी लीलाओं इत्यादि की दिव्य प्रकृति से परिचित होता है। यहाँ पर इसका
उल्लेख हुआ है कि भगवन्नाम को अधिकारियों से सुनकर उसका निरन्तर कीर्तन करना चाहिए। इसका
अर्थ यह हुआ कि अधिकारियों से श्रवण करना पहली शर्त है। पवित्र नाम का श्रवण करते रहने से,
क्रमश: मनुष्य भगवान्‌ के रूप, गुण, लीलाओं आदि के विषय में श्रवण करने की अवस्था को प्राप्त
होता है और इस तरह उत्तरोत्तर उनकी महिमा के कीर्तन की आवश्यकता उत्पन्न होती है। यह विधि न
केवल भक्ति की सफल सम्पन्नता के लिए संस्तुत की गई है, अपितु उन लोगों के लिए भी है, जो
भौतिक रूप से आसक्त हैं । श्रीशुकदेव गोस्वामी के अनुसार, सफलता प्राप्त करने की यह सुस्थापित
विधि है, जो न केवल उनके द्वारा अपितु समस्त अन्य पूर्ववर्ती आचार्यो द्वारा स्थापित की गई है।
अतएव और आगे प्रमाण देने की आवश्यकता नहीं रह जाती। यह विधि, न केवल आदर्शवादी
सफलता के विभिन्न विभाग के जिज्ञासुओं के लिए संस्तुत है, अपितु उन लोगों के लिए भी है जिन्होंने
कर्मी, दार्शनिक या भगवद्भक्त के रूप में पहले ही सफलता प्राप्त कर ली है।

6. There are various types of people who are eager to achieve success in various kinds of tasks.
Generally, these people are materialistic, who want to enjoy material satisfaction the most. After them comes the number of spiritualists who have attained complete knowledge about the nature of material enjoyment
and in this way they stay away from the deceptive style of life. By little or much, they remain satisfied in themselves through self-realization. There are even greater devotees of God, who neither desire to enjoy the material world,
nor wish to get rid of it. They remain engaged in pleasing Lord Krishna. In other words, a bhagavatam guide never makes any requests for himself. If God's
will is there, then devotees accept all material comforts, and if God does not want it,
then devotees can put all kinds of comforts, even salvation, on the shelf.
They are not.
They are self-content (Atmaram) because they desire only the pleasure of God. In this verse,
Srisukadeva Goswami praises the divine Kirtan of the Lord. By the innocent feeling of the holy name of God,
through chanting and listening, a person first becomes acquainted with the divine form of God, then with the
qualities of God, and then with the divine nature of His divine plays, etc. Here, it is mentioned that after hearing the name of God from the authorities, one should continuously chant it. Its meaning is that listening to the authorities is the first condition. By constantly listening to the holy name,
gradually a person attains the state of listening about the form, qualities, pastimes, etc., of God,
and in this way, there is a need for continuously chanting His glory. This method is not
only prescribed for the successful completion of devotion, but also for those who
are physically attached.
According to Srishukdev Goswami, this is a well-established
method for achieving success, which has been established not only by him but by all other predecessor Acharyas. Therefore, there is no need to provide further evidence. This method is not only for idealists,
but also for those who have already achieved success as workers, philosophers, or devotees of God.
